input: Find founder-owned US specialty chemical distributors with 50-250 employees and no private equity owner

companies.name: Aal Chem LLC
companies.employees: 51–200 employees; as_of: 2026-11-10 observation of Indeed's undated company-size estimate. The company separately reports more than 80 employees on its undated website. source_url: https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Aal-Chem-2

criteria_evidence.criterion: US headquarters, domain, and founding year
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company identifies Grand Rapids, Michigan as its headquarters, uses aalchem.com, and states that Kaz Darehshori started the business in 2002. Observed 2026-11-10.
Wholesale chemical distributor serving paints and coatings, adhesives and sealants, graphic arts, composites, additives, and plastics.
The company's leadership page identifies Kaz Darehshori as Owner & President and explicitly describes him as the founder. Observed 2026-11-10.

Indeed lists company size as 51–200 employees. This corroborates the company's own statement that its workforce exceeds 80 employees. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation; underlying estimate date undisclosed.

criteria_evidence.criterion: Private company; no identified private equity owner
criteria_evidence.evidence: Craft classifies Aal Chem as private and identifies founder Kaz Darehshori as Owner & President. No PE acquisition was identified in the accessible company news or targeted ownership searches through 2026-11-10; this is a public-source ownership screen, not a complete cap-table verification.
Reviewed the company's accessible news archive on 2026-11-10. The archive includes supplier and product announcements; no PE ownership transaction was identified.

companies.traction: More than 600 customers reported by the company. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation of an undated statement; underlying measurement date undisclosed. source_url: https://aalchem.com/about
companies.rank_reason: Strongest distribution-focused fit: explicit founder-owner identification on the company's own site, a corroborated qualifying employee band, and a clear specialty portfolio concentrated in formulation-driven industrial markets.

companies.name: GreenChem Industries, LLC
companies.hq: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
companies.employees: 51–200 employees; as_of: 2026-11-10 observation of the company's LinkedIn size band. source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/greenchem-industries

criteria_evidence.evidence: Florida's registry identifies the active entity as GREENCHEM INDUSTRIES, LLC, with its principal address in West Palm Beach, Florida, and John Lagae as CEO. Its annual report was filed on 2026-02-06.
The company's website identifies its founder as John Lagae and its founding year as 2007. Observed 2026-11-10.
The company explicitly supplies industrial and specialty chemicals and provides chemical sourcing, bulk distribution, warehousing, packaging, and logistics services.
John Lagae, independently identified as the founder on the company's website, is identified as Chief Executive Officer / Owner. Observed 2026-11-10.
The company's LinkedIn profile reports a 51–200 employee company-size band and classifies it as privately held. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

In Global Business Reports' APLA 2024 report, GreenChem's managing director describes it as a US family-owned company with entirely organic growth. Combined with the named founder-owner evidence, this supports independent ownership. No subsequent PE transaction was identified through 2026-11-10; ownership percentages are not publicly disclosed.
Reviewed the accessible company news page on 2026-11-10. No PE ownership announcement was identified; the page highlights sustainability recognition.

companies.headcount_growth: Estimated employees: 60 as_of 2023-04-12, source_url: https://www.owler.com/company/greenchemindustries ; approximately 92 as_of 2026-08, source_url: https://leadiq.com/c/greenchem-industries/5a1d8eb25400005b0074d478 . These are different providers' estimates, so a directly comparable growth rate is not established.
companies.traction: Recognized by the Alliance for Chemical Distribution for its commitment to Responsible Distribution. as_of: 2025-08-14. This was additional recognition, not the principal Excellence Award. source_url: https://www.acd-chem.com/media-center/press-releases/acd-recognizes-imcd-u-s-llc-with-2025-responsible-distribution-excellence-award/
companies.rank_reason: Strong distributor fit with a qualifying company-reported size band, named founder-owner, state-registry corroboration, and independent family-ownership reporting. Ranked below Aal Chem because its portfolio includes substantial bulk and commodity chemicals and its ownership evidence spans multiple sources.

companies.name: Miles Chemical Company Inc.
companies.employees: 51–200 employees; as_of: 2026-11-10 observation of the company's LinkedIn size band. A company presentation also reports more than 100 employees as_of 2024. source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/miles-chemical-inc-

criteria_evidence.evidence: A January 7, 2026 industry report identifies Miles Chemical as a privately owned corporation headquartered in Arleta, California, established in 1996 by Anthony Miles.

The company's site identifies chemical distribution as a business segment serving surface finishing, electronics and semiconductors, personal care, food and beverage, and water treatment, alongside technical support and custom blending.
An interview explicitly identifies founder Anthony Miles and his wife Gina as the company's owners. as_of: 2021-01-07.

California's Water Boards registry classifies Miles Chemical Company as a privately owned business and lists Anthony Miles as an Owner Contact. Observed 2026-11-10. This corroborates the founder connection but does not disclose equity percentages.
The company's LinkedIn profile reports 51–200 employees. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

The January 7, 2026 anniversary report continues to describe the company as privately owned and discusses its future with Anthony Miles and his family. No subsequent PE transaction was identified in the ownership and company-news review through 2026-11-10.
Reviewed the company's accessible press-release page on 2026-11-10; no PE acquisition announcement was identified.

companies.headcount_growth: 100 employees as_of 2021-01-07, source_url: https://finishingandcoating.com/index.php/plating/480-24-years-later-miles-chemical-still-delivers-to-finishing-industry ; more than 100 employees in the company's 2024 presentation, source_url: https://usmcocca.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/USMCOCCA-member-miles-chemical-company-inc-2024.pdf . The later count is open-ended, so an exact growth rate cannot be established.
companies.traction: Approximately $75 million in sales reported for 2023 in the company's 2024 chamber presentation. as_of: 2023. source_url: https://usmcocca.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/USMCOCCA-member-miles-chemical-company-inc-2024.pdf
companies.rank_reason: Explicit founder-and-spouse ownership evidence, current regulatory corroboration, and a qualifying employee band. Specialty distribution is material, but environmental services, logistics, and blending make it less distribution-focused than the higher-ranked companies.

companies.name: Seacole (Seacole-CRC, LLC)
companies.employees: Approximately 56 employees; as_of: 2026-04, LeadIQ estimate. source_url: https://leadiq.com/c/seacole/5a1d8dcf5400005400744c52/employee-directory . Glassdoor corroborates a 51–200 employee band, observed 2026-11-10; source_url: https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Seacole-EI_IE1902369.11,18.htm

criteria_evidence.criterion: Exact entity, domain, and US headquarters
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company's careers page identifies Seacole-CRC, LLC of Plymouth, Minnesota. Its operating website is seacole.com. Observed 2026-11-10.
The company's history states that Gregg Elliott founded Seacole in 2002 and acquired Circuit Research Corporation. The predecessor's earlier founding date is not used as Seacole's founding year.

The company states that it distributes products from other manufacturers in addition to selling proprietary formulations. Markets include surface finishing, microelectronics, printed circuit boards, industrial cleaning, and agriculture.
The company's leadership page explicitly identifies Gregg Elliott as Founder, Owner & CEO. Observed 2026-11-10.
LeadIQ estimates approximately 56 employees as_of 2026-04. Its headquarters address and named owner match Seacole in Plymouth, Minnesota.

criteria_evidence.criterion: Private company; no identified private equity owner
criteria_evidence.evidence: Glassdoor identifies Seacole as a private company. The company's own leadership page continues to identify its founder as owner, and no PE transaction was identified in the accessible disclosures reviewed through 2026-11-10.
Reviewed the company's homepage news listings through October 2026 on 2026-11-10. Recent announcements concern products and a distribution partnership; no PE ownership announcement was identified.

companies.headcount_growth: Nearly 50 employees as_of 2016-02-10, source_url: https://seacole.com/its-not-just-for-compliance-anymore/ ; approximately 56 employees as_of 2026-04, source_url: https://leadiq.com/c/seacole/5a1d8dcf5400005400744c52/employee-directory . Approximate counts from different sources do not establish a precise growth rate.
companies.traction: Announced a new distribution partnership with MKS' Atotech ELWAF division supporting the printed circuit board market. as_of: 2026-10-13. source_url: https://seacole.com/
companies.rank_reason: Clear primary-source founder ownership and genuine third-party specialty chemical distribution, with a qualifying employee estimate. Ranked lower because manufacturing, proprietary formulations, and contract blending are substantial components of the business.

output.search_notes: Screen as_of: 2026-11-10. US means US-headquartered; employee figures are company-wide estimates, not US-only counts. Undated sources are labeled with observation dates rather than represented as newly measured data. Founder-owned was not equated with merely founder-led, family-owned, or employee-owned. The no-PE screen combines affirmative founder-owner evidence with company-news and targeted ownership searches; public disclosures do not provide complete cap tables, so direct shareholder confirmation remains necessary before investment outreach. Sources included company sites, association publications, a chamber presentation, state records, local/trade reporting, and employment databases. PE exclusion cross-check: EMCO was excluded; Lindsay Goldberg's portfolio identifies it as a current investment with initial investment in 2025, source_url: https://www.lindsaygoldbergllc.com/investments/emco-chemical-distributors . The sponsor's acquisition announcement also reports more than 500 employees as_of 2025-11-10, source_url: https://www.lindsaygoldbergllc.com/news/lindsay-goldberg-to-acquire-emco-chemical-distributors . missing_fields: Aal Chem LLC=[headcount_growth, last_round]; GreenChem Industries, LLC=[last_round]; Miles Chemical Company Inc.=[last_round]; Seacole=[last_round]. Aal Chem's website provides a historical count for 2002 and an undated later count, but not two reliably dated measurements. No verified latest funding round was found for the returned companies; null does not mean that no financing has occurred. Additional candidates were omitted when founder ownership or the employee threshold could not be substantiated; the search does not establish a complete census of the market.

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
